packaged_source_validation.environment: Python 3.11, MCP SDK 1.26.0, isolated temporary source directory
checks: Real MCP stdio transport discovers all 18 tools
Checkout arithmetic returns 185.00 for the test fixture
Missing shipping information blocks checkout calculation

origin.description: Packaged from an existing personal Hermes shopping integration. Module imports and paths were adapted for installation and environment variables.
original_deployment_observations: Public search retrieved product links and public evidence
origin.deployment_note: The published package has not replaced the existing production deployment. Original deployment observations are not end-to-end proof for a new installation.

Platform-wide price history or current validity of indexed promotions
Ordering, payments and automatic coupon claiming
privacy: Only source, synthetic tests and this sanitized receipt are published. No account cookies, credentials, user databases, private session logs or delivery addresses are included.
